description: Following approval for erection of a single storey infill extension to north elevation of building, new window openings to west and south elevations, new canopies to east and west elevations, the erection of a 1.8 metre high security fence along the perimeter of south and east elevations of the existing building, and demolition of 'lantern' roof light at the southwest corner of the building and construction of a new flat roof that is flush with the existing roof with a new landscaped pathway, proposed dog walking area (located on an area of hard standing currently used informally as a car parking area), and a small footpath / paved area - details submitted pursuant to Condition 5 (Hard and Soft Landscape) of approved planning permission ref 01137/F/P18 dated 20/10/2005
